description: A gently raised, sinuous linear ridge trending NE–SW through the center of the LiDAR terrain model, approximately 4–6 m wide and standing ~0.5 m above the surrounding low‐relief surface. It exhibits straight segments joined by subtle curves at regular intervals—consistent with an engineered causeway or elevated pathway.

A secondary linear feature branching off the main ridge toward the southeast, forming an L‐shaped junction. This branch is narrower (~3 m) and slightly lower (~0.3 m), potentially representing a drainage canal feeding into the main causeway system.
